The vendor directly providing the software product at **tawk.to** is **tawk.to inc.** (trading as **tawk.to**).

### Evidence
According to the official [Terms of Service](https://www.tawk.to/terms-of-service/) for the website and services at **tawk.to**:
> *"These Terms of Service govern your use of the tawk.to website and all of the products and services offered by tawk.to inc."*  
> *"The tawk.to service that allows website owners to monitor and chat with visitors on their website is maintained by tawk.to inc. trading as tawk.to."*
